pelage_geometry_and_topology.patch_morphology: Dark patches exhibit high edge angularity with serrated borders. Relative spatial area is maximal on the mid-flank, with patch density increasing and area decreasing toward the posterior limbs.
pelage_geometry_and_topology.corridor_network: Continuous network of light-colored corridors. Junction nodes are predominantly tri-radial. Path thickness increases from the dorsal ridge toward the ventral region.

dorsal_ridge_profile.edge_serration: Low-amplitude, high-frequency serrated contour along the dorsal neck mane, transitioning into a smoother profile at the shoulder hump.

focal_dorsal_anomalies.chronic_feeding_lesions: A localized area of dense, dark hyper-pigmentation and textural disruption is visible on the upper shoulder/base of neck region.
